environment: Disposable PostgreSQL 17 + real GoTrue + real PostgREST + real Storage API v1.98.6 (file backend).

tests.name: anonymous cannot write order status or call privileged checkout
Coming Soon cannot be ordered even through trusted server RPC
catalog includes 15 products, without fabricated ratings or sales columns
server prices + concurrent idempotency create one complete order
invalid/missing product aborts checkout with no orphan order
RLS hides another buyer order and blocks role/VIP escalation
wrong amount and mode cannot mark paid or grant downloads
payment + grant + audit/outbox commit together and duplicate event is idempotent
bank reference cannot be reused on a different order
duplicate canonical slip hash is rejected across orders
single-use coupon cannot be oversubscribed concurrently
school provisioning is atomic and adds owner membership
application validates grade, round and school before storing data
cross-school staff and content editor cannot access private student data
cross-school review and client status manipulation are denied
applicant receives the decision and note only after publication
refund revokes grants and users cannot reinstate them
distributed rate limiter stops repeated requests
all application tables enable RLS and storage buckets stay private
outbox workers lease disjoint events and daily summary is idempotent
restrictive storage fence blocks legacy permissive policies only on new buckets
document registration is atomic and blocked after review
support creation and notification commit together with private read access
untested replacement release preserves old downloads and requires matching hash attestation
